name: hud_sensor_tracker_set_objective_review_visible
description: HudSensorTracker::SetObjectiveReviewVisible shows the current objective review, attempts the completed-objectives fallback review through the HUD objective provider, or hides the review and restores sound volume/flag state. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent HudSensorTracker objective-command cluster because this helper depends on HudUiMgrObjective panel layout, zLoc provider state, and zSound global state.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x418620 validates setting objectiveFlowState to 0x65, visible mode 1, first-incomplete objective slot display when firstIncompleteObjectiveIndex is below objectiveCount, completed-objective fallback call through zLoc::GetMessageString(0x0f0f) with a null description argument, hide mode 0 through HudUiMgrObjective::Begin, zSnd::SetGlobalVolumeScale(g_HudSensorTracker.hudScale), and zSnd::SetFlag10PlaybackEnabled(1).

The native objective-panel smoke verifies the visible first-incomplete path, the completed fallback's current provider behavior where HudUiMgrObjective::Show ignores the null-description call and leaves existing panel text unchanged, the hide path, restored global volume scale, and flag-10 playback enable side effect.
